$comment: Developer-only routing cases for the evolution Step 18 benchmark. Expected outcomes were written from each Skill's stated scope and boundary clause before any proxy or provider result existed, and are never tuned to a proxy. A case applies to every scenario that contains all the Skills it names. expect.any_of: one of these must load. expect.also_allowed: may load as well without counting as wrong. expect.forbid: must not load (reported separately). expect.none: no Chayen Skill may load. expect.none_or: nothing, or only these. expect.inspect_first: the agent inspects the repository before choosing. lexical: keyword (shares scope words with the expected description) or paraphrase (deliberately avoids them). Regression prompts are copied verbatim from the Phase 5 probes they cite.

objective.source: OWN-05 quality objective, per supported CLI, never pooled across provider or model configurations
